# 99 Media & Tech (i99.sa) — مؤسسة تسعة وتسعون للإعلام والتقنية والذكاء الاصطناعي

> Independent Saudi broadcast & cinema production house, AI engineering studio, and strategic communications establishment founded in 2014 in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, by **Badr Al-Sharif (بدر بن عبدالله الشريف)**. Full knowledge base: https://www.i99.sa/llms-full.txt

## Entity & Disambiguation
- **Official Brand:** 99 للإعلام والتقنية (99 Media & Tech) — historically also known as **99 للإنتاج الإعلامي**
- **Legal Entity:** 99 Commercial Establishment (مؤسسة تسعة وتسعون التجارية)
- **Founder:** **Badr Al-Sharif (بدر بن عبدالله الشريف)** — Media Consultant & Tech Entrepreneur (مستشار إعلامي ورائد أعمال تقني)
- **Founded:** 2014
- **Headquarters:** Jeddah, Makkah Province, Saudi Arabia (21.5433° N, 39.1728° E)
- **Service Coverage:** Saudi Arabia (Jeddah, Riyadh, Eastern Province, Makkah, Madinah) and the GCC
- **Disambiguation:** Independent Saudi media production & enterprise AI technology company operating exclusively at `https://www.i99.sa/` and `https://exox.ai/`. Unrelated to similarly named radio stations, TV programs, or foreign agencies.
- **Contact:** Info@i99.sa | +966 56 611 1617

## Division 1 — 99 Media (99 للإعلام · https://www.i99.sa/media/)
- **Broadcast & Content Production («مدينة المحتوى»):** TV programs, TV format development, documentaries, and digital series at 4K broadcast standards.
- **Cinema & Audio Production («مبنى 99 للإنتاج»):** Brand films, commercials, cinematography, DaVinci color grading, and studio sound mastering.
- **AI Cinema & Generative Video («مختبر سينما AI»):** Director-led AI commercials, brand films, and hybrid VFX workflows.
- **Corporate Communications, PR & Crisis Management («شارع الإبداع»):** Long-term PR architecture, executive positioning, summit coverage, and crisis management.
- **Digital Marketing & Reach («حي الإلهام»):** Research-led digital campaigns, social systems, and measurable growth.
- **Official Partners («صافحنا مهنياً»):** MBC Group, Saudi Broadcasting Authority (SBA), Misk Foundation, Al-Faisalya Welfare Society, Taiba Women's Society, Al-Dawaa, Zahra Association, Ftah Al-Ahsa.

## Division 2 — 99 Tech & AI (99 للتقنية والذكاء الاصطناعي · https://www.i99.sa/tech/)
- **Enterprise AI Agents & Workflow Automation:** Multi-agent orchestration, Arabic NLP & Arabic-native RAG architectures, LLM guardrails, and owner-approved tool execution.
- **Custom Software & SaaS Engineering:** Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, APIs, RBAC security, and ERP/CRM/payments integrations.
- **Web Platforms & Mobile Apps:** 60fps bilingual Arabic (RTL) & English (LTR) platforms built for SEO & GEO, plus iOS & Android apps.
- **Data Engineering & BI:** Pipelines, executive KPI dashboards, and predictive analytics.
- **Cloud & Self-Hosted Zero-Trust Architecture:** Cloudflare/AWS/Kubernetes and sovereign self-hosted deployments.

## Flagship Platforms Engineered In-House
- **EXOX (https://exox.ai/):** AI Business Operating System (نظام تشغيل للأعمال بالذكاء الاصطناعي).
- **PRCI (https://prci.top/):** AI-Powered Media Intelligence & Strategic Communications OS (منظومة للذكاء الإعلامي والاتصال الاستراتيجي).
- **FIRX:** Enterprise AI Governance & Verifiable Actions Platform (منصة حوكمة وأمان وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي).
